title: Agency Team

owner.title: 1. Owner
owner.description: Full legal and financial control. Receives CCP / BNA payouts, configures agency settings and manages billing.

admin.title: 2. Admin
admin.description: Listing and fleet management. Can create and edit listings, adjust prices, manage the calendar and invite team members.

manager.title: 3. Manager / staff
manager.description: Day-to-day operations. Can view incoming reservations, message guests, coordinate check-in/check-out and check calendar availability.

invite.title: Invite a team member
invite.emailRequired: Enter a valid work email address.
invite.description: They get an email invitation and join your workspace with the role you choose.

removeDialog.title: Revoke team access
removeDialog.message: Remove {name} from {organization}? They will immediately lose access to your agency dashboard, calendar and bookings.

transferDialog.title: Transfer ownership
transferDialog.message: Make {name} the owner of {organization}? You will become an admin.

toasts.ownerCannotBeRemoved: The organization owner can't be removed.
